label: Customer name
hint: Company name as the audience says it.

label: Where they operate
hint: Footprint: region, network size, HQ city.
example: US Midwest: about 4,800 route miles of rail plus 9 intermodal terminals, headquartered in Kansas City, MO

label: Audience
hint: Roles (and names only if public) who will explore the briefing.
example: Northwind Freight CISO and VP of Network Operations

label: Goal of the briefing
hint: What the audience should believe or decide after exploring.
example: Show that every trackside and terminal site can become a monitored, segmented sensor, and agree on a 10-site pilot on the Kansas City to Chicago corridor.

label: Cisco topic
hint: The Cisco solution theme the scenarios illustrate.
example: Industrial IoT security and assurance for wayside and intermodal terminal OT networks

label: Cisco technologies to feature
hint: 6 to 8 products, comma separated. The SIEM is added automatically.
example: Cisco IE3500 switch, Catalyst IR1101 router, Cyber Vision, Identity Services Engine, Catalyst Center, ThousandEyes, Cisco XDR

label: Time budget (hours)
hint: Total hours for research, build and review.

label: Presenter
hint: Who drives it live (name and role).

label: SIEM
hint: The SOC's SIEM; mark as assumed if not public.

label: Brand subtitle
hint: 3 to 4 word mission shown under 'Cisco for <customer>'.

label: Site to model in 3D
hint: The representative field site for the diorama.
example: an intermodal terminal gate and adjacent wayside control point

label: Site view button label
hint: Short label for the second view in the top bar.

label: Site view hash key
hint: One lowercase word used in URLs and file names.

label: Field assets in the site
example: gate OCR portal, crane controller, reefer power posts, wayside signal, grade crossing, hot box detector, equipment shelter, carrier 5G tower

label: Map region
example: US Midwest and Great Plains (us-atlas states)

label: Telemetry hub
hint: Where field telemetry lands (place and lon/lat).
